titles: Build a CLI That Summarizes Meeting Notes with AI
Summarize Meeting Notes in 4 Seconds with AI
OpenAI + Dotenv CLI: Bullets and Action Items
publish.description: Watch a tiny command line tool get built in about two minutes that summarizes markdown meeting notes with an AI model. You will see how to install the OpenAI client and dotenv, store the key in a .env file, and call the chat completions endpoint to print bullet points with action items. It also covers adding a friendly error handler for a missing file and previews streaming for the next video.
highlights: Build a CLI that summarizes meeting notes with AI
Install OpenAI client and dotenv, use .env for key
Call chat completions to get bullets and action items
Add friendly error message for missing file
